newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index rises in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index rises in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index rose 64 points or 2.33 percent last week. The All Ordinaries index fell 1.05 percent.
Aug 30 Aug 23 pct 1 Month 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
"The Eyres Reed Explorer Index moved ahead 64 points this week as market players began to refocuc on speculative resource stocks," Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary.
"As a result, prices were more responsive to news and expected news from the explorers," he said.
"Despite this, risers and falls were roughly equal in number."

Stars of the week included diamond explorer Diamin Resources NL, up 2.9 cents at 7.1 cents, as the company drilled for kimberlite at the Mad Gap Yard prospect in northern Western Australia. Striker Resources NL, another diamond
hopeful, jumped five cents to 19 cents, awakening from a long period in the doldrums, while gold explorer Julia Mines NL rose four cents to 22 cents.

Other strong moves included Leo Shield Exploration NL, up 10 cents to 56 cents, Camelot Resources NL up five cents to 31 cents, Northern Gold NL, up 10 cents to 35 cents, and Troy Resources NL, up 10 to 70.
Roebuck Resources NL continued its roller coaster ride, falling 12 cents to 50 cents.
Oil and gas junior Victoria Petroleum NL eased 0.9 cents to 4.1 cents, Nugold Hill Gold Mines NL eased 0.9 to six cents and Tribune Resources NL eased 1.5 to 13 cents.
